goal: Refactor before we add more commands: `main` in salesdesk/cli.py has become one long if/elif chain over args.command. Give every command its own handler function named `cmd_<command>` (dashes become underscores, e.g. `cmd_add_customer`) taking `(service, args, out)` where service is the ReportService, and register it on its subparser with `set_defaults(handler=...)`. `main` should then only set things up, call `args.handler(service, args, out)` and return what the handler returns as the exit status, keeping all the error handling in that one place. Nothing a user sees may change: every command's output and exit status must stay exactly as it is.
